title: Measles Needs 95% Protection Because One Case Spreads Fast
hook: A tiny immunity gap is enough. Measles needs 95% protection.
closing: Even a few unprotected kids can reopen the door, so every vaccine keeps your town safe.
question: Did you get both measles shots?

segments.say: One measles case infects about fifteen people, far more than flu. So it spreads fast the moment protection slips.
Measles is only stopped when ninety-five percent of kids are protected. Kindergartners fall just short, and the virus finds every gap.
US measles cases grew about nine times recently. A small protection gap let each outbreak snowball.
